root.description: Repository root path; populated by the harness at startup so direct-check guards (e.g. planning_complete) can locate CONTRACTS / TASKS under docs/. Not persisted across harness restarts; not required by transition semantics.

round_entry.description: The transition that opened the active S7 round. TR-012 entries carry the exact repair handoff and change_impact evidence references used to freeze the post-repair baseline.

plan.description: The registered S7 ReviewPlan pointer (L3-S7 §3.2). Claim/assignment content lives in the pinned plan file; the runtime holds identity, hash and status under CAS.

verification_artifact_digest.description: sha256 over the workspace's relative-path:file-hash lines at plan registration (E2E cold_start only); the seal/clean close recomputes and rejects drift.

claims.description: Consumer-maintained disposition projection for the current plan (L3-S7 §3.5 round-level disposition). Written only inside the review-plan / review-result CAS transactions.

assignments.description: Consumer-maintained Assignment consumption view keyed by assignment_id.

queued_agent_id.description: Agent registered for a resource-lock-queued Assignment; the scheduler promotes it when the holder is consumed.

blocker_ref.description: Canonical S7 site-lost blocker artifact; present only while this Assignment is blocked.

blocked_at.description: UTC timestamp at which the Assignment entered the explicit S7 blocker state.

artifact_digest.description: The verification workspace digest the consumed E2E result ran against (L3-S7 §10.1.6).

resource_locks.description: Sorted unique non-empty union of the Assignment's declared locks plus the locks declared on each of its Claims (computed via mergedResourceLocks); consulted for dispatch conflict detection and queueing (L3-S7 §4.5, L4 §6.2). Absent/null when no claim/assignment in this round declares any lock.

queue_reason.description: Recorded queue-cause identifier when the scheduler queues this Assignment behind a held resource lock; null when the Assignment is ready or already consumed (L3-S7 §4.5).

observation_batch.description: The sealed S7 -> S8 handoff pointer (L3-S7 §3.7); null while the round is still discovering.

investigation_baseline_drift.description: RC-18 S8-H3: the latest baseline-digest drift warning from investigation Case revisions, or null while the Case baseline matches the frozen ReviewPlan subjects. Read-only projection for `runtime investigation status`; the Case artifact's pinned baseline_digest is never rewritten.

investigation.description: The S8 InvestigationCase intake pointer. The Case artifact is the authority; this runtime field is only its CAS-pinned identity and status projection.

repair.description: The S9 RepairSession pointer. Domain artifacts remain authoritative; Runtime pins their identity, revision and current next action for CAS recovery.

authority_fingerprint.description: RC-09 (S9-4): repository baseline digest captured when each RepairSession opened, keyed by session id. Repair commits re-verify the live digest against the pinned fingerprint and fail stale on drift.

required_reverification_ids.description: RC-09 (S9-6): targeted reverification ids the ChangeImpact declared as mandatory. Repair handoff is blocked until every id resolves to a committed targeted_reverification artifact.

findings.description: Immutable S7 Finding index rows (L3-S7 §3.6). Full content lives in the pinned finding file; rows are never mutated after creation.

finding_supplements.description: Append-only FindingSupplement index rows (L3-S7 §3.6, L3-S8 §2.2). Each row is the control-plane pointer to one persisted supplement artifact hanging under an immutable Finding; rows are never mutated after creation. Written exclusively by `runtime finding-supplement` in the main runtime CAS transaction.

author_agent_id.description: Registering actor — consumed by the S5 independence check (reviewer must not be an author).

registered_at.description: ISO timestamp of the registration transition (documents are registered by PTR-PLAN-02 / TR-003 actions).

dispatch_mode.description: L4 dispatch mode captured at register-workgroup; controls whether activation_sent may follow the plan report directly (plan_checkpoint) or requires understanding_approved first (plan_approval_required).

blocking.description: Explicit business-blocking marker carried from the Finding into the canonical BUG (RC-02). P0 Findings are implicitly blocking=true.

supplements_finding_id.description: The immutable Finding this supplement hangs under. The Finding row and the sealed ObservationBatch finding_ids set never change.

authorized_by.description: Scheduler identity that authorized a replacement finder when author != the Finding's original_finder (L3-S8 §2.2). Absent when the original finder authored the supplement.

hypothesis_id.description: Registered S8 Hypothesis the discriminator distinguishes. Present exactly on discriminator-bound follow-up observations; S7 in-round notes never carry it.

discriminator.description: The S8 discriminator this observation answers (L3-S8 §2.1/§8). Present exactly on discriminator-bound follow-up observations.

blocking.description: Explicit business-blocking marker (RC-02, L3-S7 §10.1). P0 BUGs are implicitly blocking=true; a non-P0 BUG with blocking=true blocks the clean round exactly like a P0 — blocking is a business judgment, never a severity synonym.
